title: Create Table [TIMESTAMP and DEFAULT]
description:
There is one more core datatype of columns in sql. That is `TIMESTAMP`. Timestamp is a timestamp (duh), and it is usefull for tracking created at dates, updated at dates... Another important thing is DEFAULT. This means that when this column isnt set in a row, it is auto-assigned to the value stated. There is a special thing you can do to default to the current timestamp for `TIMESTAMP`s, and that is `DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`.
## Assignment:
BWS needs the instances table to have created and updated at fields. Replace the uptime field with 2 timestamps, created_at and updated_at that both default to current timestamp.
runHarness:
INSERT INTO instances (id, name, status) VALUES (1, 'BWS-1', 'running');
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='instances';
